claim: v3 denoising-dirty-documents with opus-everywhere achieved medal=GOLD at score 0.0123 (silver=~0.02, gold threshold lower), total $10.59. Combined with Phase 1 denoising-opus (also intended to be opus-all but blocked by v3 selector residual bug), this gives n=1 confirmed gold for opus-all on denoising. Compared to the Phase 2 sonnet/haiku denoising routings (X203 silver, X210 X211 X213 none-tier), opus-all is the only config so far to clear gold. Per-role: coder=$4.94 dominates, followed by aggregator $1.33 and evaluator $1.50. Total ~3x cheaper than leaf-classification opus-all ($26.52) for far better medal outcome.
